Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The modified push up to lower arms is a bodyweight exercise targeting the forearms, with secondary emphasis on the triceps, chest, and shoulders. It involves transitioning from a push-up position to lowering the forearms to the ground and then pressing back up.

name: Smith Seated Wrist Curl
nameRu: Сгибание запястий в тренажере Смита сидя
instructions: Sit on a bench in front of a Smith machine with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, allowing your wrists to hang off.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, bringing the barbell towards your forearms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith seated wrist curl is an isolation exercise targeting the forearms, performed using a Smith machine. It involves curling the wrists upward while seated, with the forearms resting on the thighs.

name: Wrist Circles
instructions: Extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Make a fist with both hands.
Rotate your wrists in a circular motion, keeping your arms still.
Continue the wrist circles for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Wrist circles are a bodyweight exercise focused on improving mobility and flexibility in the wrists and forearms. This movement is commonly used as a warm-up or rehabilitation exercise to increase blood flow and prepare the wrists for more strenuous activities.

name: Dumbbell Finger Curls
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with an underhand grip, resting your forearm on your thigh, palm facing up.
Allow the dumbbell to roll down to your fingertips, then curl it back up by flexing your fingers.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other hand.
description: Dumbbell finger curls are an isolation exercise targeting the forearms, specifically the muscles responsible for finger flexion. This exercise helps improve grip strength and forearm development.

name: Dumbbell Over Bench One Arm Reverse Wrist Curl
nameRu: Разгибание запястья с гантелью одной рукой на скамье
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing down.
Rest your forearm on the bench with your wrist hanging off the edge.
Slowly curl your wrist upwards, bringing the dumbbell towards your forearm.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: The dumbbell over bench one arm reverse wrist curl targets the forearms, specifically the extensors, and is performed by curling the wrist upwards while the forearm is supported on a bench.

name: Lever Gripper Hands
instructions: Adjust the seat height and grip the handles of the leverage machine.
Keep your back straight and your feet flat on the ground.
Exhale and squeeze the handles, contracting your forearms.
Hold the contraction for a second, then slowly release and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever gripper hands exercise targets the forearms using a leverage machine. It involves gripping and squeezing the handles to strengthen the forearm muscles, with secondary activation of the biceps and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Lying Pronation On Floor
nameRu: Пронация с гантелью лежа на полу
instructions: Lie flat on the floor with your face down and your arms extended straight out in front of you, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Rotate your palms so they are facing down towards the floor.
Keeping your arms straight, lift the dumbbells off the floor by contracting your forearms.
Continue lifting until your forearms are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell lying pronation on floor targets the forearms by requiring you to rotate your palms downward while lifting dumbbells, emphasizing forearm strength and stability.

name: Dumbbell Lying Supination On Floor
nameRu: Супинация с гантелью лежа на полу
instructions: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your legs extended and your arms by your sides, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Rotate your palms to face up, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Slowly curl the dumbbells towards your shoulders, squeezing your forearms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell lying supination on floor is an isolation exercise targeting the forearms, with secondary engagement of the biceps and shoulders. It involves lying on your back and performing a supination curl motion with dumbbells.

name: Barbell Seated Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки со штангой сидя
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and a barbell resting on your thighs.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised platform, such as a block or step.
Position the barbell across your thighs and hold it securely with your hands.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, lift your heels off the ground by extending your ankles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell seated calf raise is an exercise that targets the calf muscles by lifting a barbell placed on the thighs while seated. It primarily focuses on strengthening the calves and also engages the hamstrings and quadriceps as secondary muscles.

name: Barbell Standing Leg Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки со штангой стоя
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place a barbell across your upper back.
Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, using your calves.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell standing leg calf raise is a strength exercise targeting the calves. It involves standing with a barbell across your upper back and raising your heels off the ground to engage the calf muscles.

name: Barbell Standing Rocking Leg Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки со штангой стоя с раскачкой
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell across your upper back.
Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, balancing on the balls of your feet.
Slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell standing rocking leg calf raise targets the calves and involves raising your heels while balancing a barbell across your upper back. This exercise also engages the hamstrings and quadriceps as secondary muscles.

name: Circles Knee Stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Bend your knees slightly and lift your heels off the ground, balancing on the balls of your feet.
Keeping your knees bent, rotate your knees in a circular motion, first clockwise and then counterclockwise.
Perform the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The circles knee stretch is a bodyweight exercise that targets the calves and also engages the hamstrings and quadriceps. It involves standing on the balls of your feet with knees bent and rotating the knees in circular motions to improve mobility and flexibility in the lower legs.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with your toes on an elevated surface, such as a step or block.
Place your hands on a stable support, such as a wall or railing, for balance.
Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The donkey calf raise is a bodyweight exercise that targets the calves. It involves standing with your toes on an elevated surface and raising your heels as high as possible to work the calf muscles.

name: Dumbbell Seated One Leg Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки сидя с гантелью одной ногой
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell resting on your right thigh.
Extend your left leg straight out in front of you, keeping your foot flexed.
Place the ball of your right foot on an elevated surface, such as a step or weight plate.
Using your calf muscles, raise your right heel as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The dumbbell seated one leg calf raise is an isolation exercise targeting the calf muscles, performed while seated with a dumbbell placed on the working thigh. It helps build strength and muscle in the calves, with some engagement of the hamstrings and glutes for stabilization.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки с гантелью одной ногой
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step or platform with your heels hanging off and your toes on the step.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and place your other hand on a wall or railing for support.
Raise your heel as high as possible, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down below the step.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.
description: The dumbbell single leg calf raise is a unilateral lower leg exercise that targets the calves, performed while holding a dumbbell for added resistance. It challenges balance and strength by isolating one leg at a time.

name: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки стоя с гантелями
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, using your calves.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell standing calf raise is an exercise that targets the calf muscles by lifting the heels off the ground while holding dumbbells for added resistance.

name: Lever Seated Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки сидя в тренажере
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are slightly bent and your feet are flat on the footplate.
Place your toes on the footplate with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the seat for stability.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated calf raise is a machine-based exercise that targets the calf muscles, particularly the gastrocnemius and soleus. It is performed while seated, using a leverage machine to provide resistance as you raise and lower your heels.

name: Lever Standing Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки стоя в тренажере
instructions: Adjust the machine to your height and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your shoulders under the pads and hold onto the handles for stability.
Raise your heels as high as possible by extending your ankles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever standing calf raise is a strength exercise performed on a leverage machine, targeting the calves. It involves raising and lowering the heels while standing, using resistance provided by the machine.

name: Single Leg Calf Raise (On A Dumbbell)
nameRu: Подъем на носки одной ногой (на гантели)
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Lift one foot off the ground and balance on the other foot.
Slowly raise your heel as high as possible, using your calf muscles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.
description: The single leg calf raise (on a dumbbell) is a lower leg exercise that targets the calves, with secondary emphasis on the ankles and feet. It involves balancing on one leg while holding a dumbbell and performing a calf raise, which increases the challenge to balance and strength.

name: Sled 45° Calf Press
nameRu: Жим носками под углом 45° в тренажере След
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a 45-degree angle.
Place your feet on the sled platform with your toes pointing forward.
Push the sled platform away from you by extending your ankles and calves.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the sled platform back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled 45° calf press is a machine-based exercise that targets the calves by pressing a weighted sled away using the balls of your feet, focusing on ankle extension.

name: Sled Forward Angled Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки с наклоном вперед в тренажере След
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight and position yourself on the machine with your toes on the platform and your heels hanging off.
Place your hands on the handles or the sides of the machine for support.
Engage your calves and slowly raise your heels as high as possible, pushing against the resistance of the sled.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled forward angled calf raise is a resistance exercise performed on a sled machine, targeting the calf muscles. The movement involves raising and lowering the heels while the toes remain on the platform, using the sled machine for added resistance.

name: Smith Reverse Calf Raises
nameRu: Обратные подъемы на носки в тренажере Смита
instructions: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height just below your shoulders.
Stand facing the bar with your feet hip-width apart and toes pointing forward.
Place the balls of your feet on the edge of a step or platform, with your heels hanging off.
Hold onto the bar for support, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith reverse calf raises is a lower leg exercise performed on a smith machine, primarily targeting the calves and secondarily engaging the hamstrings. The movement involves raising and lowering the heels while standing on a step, using the smith machine bar for support.

name: Smith Standing Leg Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки стоя в тренажере Смита
instructions: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height that allows you to stand with your feet flat on the ground and your shoulders under the bar.
Position yourself under the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on the bar for stability.
Engage your calves and slowly raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith standing leg calf raise is a lower leg exercise performed using a smith machine. It primarily targets the calves, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and glutes. The movement involves raising the heels to stand on the toes, then lowering back down, using the smith machine for stability and added resistance.

name: Weighted Donkey Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки в наклоне с отягощением
instructions: Stand on a raised platform with your toes on the edge and your heels hanging off.
Hold onto a stable object for support.
Raise your heels as high as possible by extending your ankles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The weighted donkey calf raise is a calf-focused exercise performed on a raised platform, where the lifter raises and lowers their heels while holding additional weight. This movement targets the calves and also engages the hamstrings and glutes as secondary muscles.

name: Band Single Leg Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки одной ногой с резинкой
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place the band around the ball of your left foot.
Hold onto a stable object for balance if needed.
Slowly raise your left heel off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your left heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the right leg.
description: The band single leg calf raise is a lower leg exercise that targets the calves using a resistance band. It also engages the ankles and feet, helping to improve strength and stability in the lower leg. The movement is performed one leg at a time, which increases the balance and coordination required.

name: Band Single Leg Reverse Calf Raise
nameRu: Обратный подъем на носки одной ногой с резинкой
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place the band around the ball of your foot.
Hold onto a stable object for balance.
Slowly raise your heel off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.
description: The band single leg reverse calf raise is a lower leg exercise that targets the calves, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and glutes. It uses a resistance band and requires balance and control as you raise your heel off the ground on one leg.

name: Lever Donkey Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки в наклоне в тренажере
instructions: Adjust the leverage machine to the appropriate height for your body.
Position yourself facing the machine, with your toes on the foot platform and your heels hanging off the edge.
Place your hands on the handles or the support bars for stability.
Engage your calves and lift your heels as high as possible, using the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever donkey calf raise is a machine-based exercise targeting the calf muscles. It involves standing on a platform with your heels hanging off, then raising and lowering your heels to work the calves. The leverage machine provides resistance and support, making it a controlled movement.

name: Ankle Circles
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Lift one leg off the ground and rotate your ankle in a circular motion.
Perform the desired number of circles in one direction, then switch to the other direction.
Repeat with the other leg.
description: Ankle circles are a bodyweight exercise that targets the calves and ankle stabilizers. This movement involves rotating the ankle in a circular motion while seated, helping to improve mobility and flexibility in the ankle joint.

name: Band Two Legs Calf Raise - (Band Under Both Legs) V. 2
nameRu: Подъем на носки на двух ногах с резинкой (резинка под обеими ногами) версия 2
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place a resistance band under both feet.
Hold the ends of the band with your hands for stability.
Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, using your calves.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A resistance band calf raise performed with the band under both feet, targeting the calves and also engaging the ankles and feet.

name: Barbell Floor Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки со штангой на полу
instructions: Place a barbell on the floor in front of you.
Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of the barbell, with your heels hanging off.
Hold onto a stable object for balance if needed.
Raise your heels as high as possible, using your calves to lift your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell floor calf raise is a strength exercise targeting the calves. It involves standing with the balls of your feet on a barbell and raising your heels to work the calf muscles.

name: Barbell Standing Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки стоя со штангой
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place a barbell across your upper back.
Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, using only your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell standing calf raise is a strength exercise targeting the calves. It involves standing with a barbell across your upper back and raising your heels off the ground to work the calf muscles.

name: Bodyweight Standing Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки стоя без отягощения
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on a wall or stable surface for balance.
Slowly raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The bodyweight standing calf raise is a simple exercise that targets the calf muscles. It involves lifting your heels off the ground while standing, using only your body weight for resistance. This movement helps to strengthen and tone the calves, and can also improve ankle stability.

name: Box Jump Down With One Leg Stabilization
nameRu: Спрыгивание с тумбы с приземлением на одну ногу
instructions: Stand in front of a box or platform with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and jump onto the box, landing softly with one foot on the box and the other foot hanging off the edge.
Stabilize yourself on the box with the foot that is on it, while keeping the other foot off the ground.
Hold this position for a few seconds, engaging your calf muscles to maintain balance.
Slowly step down with the foot that is on the box, returning to the starting position.
Repeat the exercise with the other leg.
description: The box jump down with one leg stabilization is a plyometric exercise that targets the calves and challenges balance and stability. It involves jumping onto a box and stabilizing on one leg, which also engages the quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes.

name: Cable Standing Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки стоя в кроссовере
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold onto the cable machine handles or attach a cable ankle strap to your ankles.
Raise your heels off the ground by extending your ankles as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable standing calf raise is an exercise that targets the calf muscles using a cable machine for resistance. It involves standing upright and raising your heels off the ground to engage the calves, with secondary activation of the hamstrings and glutes.

name: Cable Standing One Leg Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки стоя одной ногой в кроссовере
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold onto the cable machine for support.
Lift one leg off the ground and balance on the other leg.
Slowly raise your heel off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The cable standing one leg calf raise is a lower leg exercise that targets the calves using a cable machine for resistance. It is performed on one leg at a time, which increases the balance and stabilization demands.

name: Calf Stretch With Hands Against Wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands against the wall at shoulder height.
Step your right foot back, keeping your heel on the ground and your leg straight.
Bend your left knee and lean forward, keeping your back leg straight and your heel on the ground.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat the stretch.
description: A stretch targeting the calves, performed by leaning against a wall with one leg extended back and the heel pressed to the ground.

name: Calf Stretch With Rope
nameRu: Растяжка икроножных мышц с помощью веревки
instructions: Stand facing a wall or sturdy object with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold the ends of the rope in each hand and place the middle of the rope around the ball of your right foot.
Step back with your left foot, keeping your heel on the ground and your leg straight.
Lean forward, keeping your back straight, and gently pull on the rope to stretch your calf.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat on the other leg.
description: A static stretching exercise using a rope to increase flexibility in the calves and hamstrings.

name: Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки сидя с гантелями
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell resting on your thighs.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised surface such as a step or block, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Hold onto the dumbbell for stability.
Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated calf raise is an isolation exercise targeting the calf muscles, performed while seated with a dumbbell resting on the thighs. It is effective for building strength and muscle in the calves.

name: Dumbbell Seated One Leg Calf Raise - Hammer Grip
nameRu: Подъем на носки сидя с гантелью одной ногой - хват молоток
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell resting on your thighs.
Place one foot on a raised surface, such as a step or block, with your heel hanging off the edge.
Hold the dumbbell with a hammer grip, meaning your palms are facing each other and your fingers are wrapped around the handle.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, slowly raise your heel as high as possible by pushing through the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.
description: The dumbbell seated one leg calf raise - hammer grip is a lower leg exercise that targets the calves, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and glutes. It is performed seated, using a dumbbell for resistance, and involves raising and lowering the heel to strengthen the calf muscles.

name: Dumbbell Seated One Leg Calf Raise - Palm Up
nameRu: Подъем на носки сидя с гантелью одной ногой - ладонью вверх
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your back straight and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and place it on top of your thigh, palm facing up.
Lift one leg off the ground and extend it in front of you, keeping your knee slightly bent.
Raise your heel as high as possible by pushing through the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
description: The dumbbell seated one leg calf raise - palm up is an isolation exercise targeting the calf muscles, performed while seated with a dumbbell placed on the thigh. It helps build strength and muscle endurance in the calves, with some secondary activation of the hamstrings and glutes.

name: Exercise Ball On The Wall Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки с фитболом у стены
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and place an exercise ball between your lower back and the wall.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart, with your toes pointing forward.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: This exercise targets the calves by performing a calf raise while standing against a wall with an exercise ball for support and holding dumbbells for added resistance.

name: Hack Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки в тренажере Хаккеншмидта
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
Stand on the sled machine with your toes on the platform and your heels hanging off.
Hold onto the handles for stability.
Raise your heels as high as possible by pushing through the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The hack calf raise is a lower leg exercise performed on a sled machine, primarily targeting the calves. It involves raising and lowering the heels while standing on the platform, focusing on calf muscle contraction.

name: Hack One Leg Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки одной ногой в тренажере Хаккеншмидта
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to an appropriate weight.
Stand on the sled machine with one foot, keeping the other foot off the ground.
Hold onto the handles for stability.
Raise your heel as high as possible, lifting your body up on the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch legs and repeat the exercise.
description: The hack one leg calf raise is performed on a sled machine, targeting the calves with additional engagement of the hamstrings and glutes. It is executed one leg at a time, requiring balance and unilateral strength.

name: Lever Seated Squat Calf Raise On Leg Press Machine
nameRu: Подъем на носки сидя в тренажере для жима ногами
instructions: Adjust the seat of the leg press machine so that your knees are slightly bent when your feet are on the footplate.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the footplate, shoulder-width apart.
Place your toes and the balls of your feet on the footplate, keeping your heels off the edge.
Release the safety handles and push the footplate away from you by extending your knees.
Once your knees are fully extended, slowly lower your heels by flexing your calves.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the footplate back up by extending your calves.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated squat calf raise on leg press machine is an isolation exercise targeting the calves, performed on a leg press machine by extending and flexing the ankles while seated.

name: One Leg Donkey Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки в наклоне одной ногой
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on a stable surface for support, such as a wall or a bar.
Lift one leg off the ground, keeping your knee slightly bent.
Raise your heel as high as possible, using your calf muscles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The one leg donkey calf raise is a bodyweight exercise targeting the calves, performed by raising the heel of one foot while the other leg is lifted, often using a wall or bar for balance.

name: One Leg Floor Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки на полу одной ногой
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place your hands on a wall or sturdy object for balance.
Lift one foot off the ground and balance on the other foot.
Slowly raise your heel off the ground, lifting your body up onto the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
description: The one leg floor calf raise is a bodyweight exercise targeting the calves, performed by standing on one leg and raising the heel to engage the calf muscles. It also involves the ankles and feet as secondary muscles.

name: Peroneals Stretch
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Loop the rope around the ball of your foot and hold the ends of the rope with your hands.
Gently pull the rope towards you, flexing your foot and stretching your calf muscles.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Release the tension on the rope and repeat the stretch on the other leg.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The peroneals stretch is a flexibility exercise targeting the calf muscles, ankles, and feet. It uses a rope to assist in stretching the lower leg, improving mobility and reducing tightness.

name: Posterior Tibialis Stretch
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Loop the rope around the ball of your foot and hold the ends of the rope with your hands.
Gently pull the rope towards you, flexing your foot and stretching your calf muscles.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release the tension on the rope and relax your foot.
Repeat the stretch on the other leg.
description: A stretch targeting the calves using a rope to assist in flexing the foot and lengthening the posterior tibialis and calf muscles.

name: Seated Calf Stretch (Male)
instructions: Sit on the edge of a chair or bench with your feet flat on the ground.
Extend one leg straight out in front of you, keeping your heel on the ground.
Lean forward slightly, feeling a stretch in your calf muscle.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat the stretch.
description: The seated calf stretch (male) is a flexibility exercise targeting the calf muscles. It is performed while seated, requiring no equipment other than a chair or bench, and focuses on stretching the calves and, to a lesser extent, the hamstrings.

name: Sled Calf Press On Leg Press
nameRu: Жим носками в тренажере для жима ногами
instructions: Adjust the seat of the leg press machine so that your knees are slightly bent when your feet are on the sled.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the sled, with your toes pointing forward.
Release the safety handles and push the sled away from you by extending your knees and ankles.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the sled back down by bending your knees and ankles.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled calf press on leg press is an exercise that targets the calves using a sled (leg press) machine. It also engages the hamstrings and quadriceps as secondary muscles. The movement involves pressing the sled away using the balls of your feet, focusing on ankle extension.

name: Sled One Leg Calf Press On Leg Press
nameRu: Жим носками одной ногой в тренажере для жима ногами
instructions: Adjust the seat of the leg press machine so that your knees are slightly bent when your feet are on the sled.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the sled, shoulder-width apart.
Place your toes and the balls of your feet on the sled, keeping your heels off.
Push the sled forward by extending your ankles, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the sled back down by flexing your ankles.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled one leg calf press on leg press is a machine-based exercise targeting the calves, performed one leg at a time for increased isolation and intensity. It also engages the hamstrings and glutes as secondary muscles.

name: Smith One Leg Floor Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки на полу одной ногой в тренажере Смита
instructions: Position yourself on the floor under the smith machine bar, facing away from the machine.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised surface, such as a weight plate or block.
Position the smith machine bar across your lower legs, just above your ankles.
Hold onto the bar with your hands for stability.
Raise your heels off the ground by extending your ankles, lifting your body up.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith one leg floor calf raise is a lower leg exercise performed using a Smith machine. It targets the calves and also engages the hamstrings and glutes as secondary muscles. The exercise involves raising your heel off the ground while balancing on one leg, with the Smith machine bar providing resistance.

name: Smith Seated One Leg Calf Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки сидя одной ногой в тренажере Смита
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the footrest.
Place one leg on the footrest and keep the other leg off the footrest.
Using your calf muscles, raise your heel as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
description: The smith seated one leg calf raise is a lower leg exercise performed on a smith machine, targeting the calf muscles by raising one heel at a time while seated.

name: Smith Toe Raise
nameRu: Подъем на носки в тренажере Смита
instructions: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height that allows you to comfortably stand with your feet flat on the ground.
Position yourself under the bar with your shoulders directly below it and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised platform or weight plates, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your back straight throughout the exercise.
Slowly raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith toe raise is a calf exercise performed on a Smith machine, focusing on raising the heels to strengthen the calves. It uses a raised platform to increase the range of motion and is performed with the barbell resting on the shoulders.

name: Standing Calves
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, standing on your toes.
Hold the position for a moment, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The standing calves exercise is a bodyweight movement targeting the calf muscles. It involves raising your heels off the ground to stand on your toes, then lowering them back down, which helps build strength and endurance in the calves.

name: Standing Calves Calf Stretch
instructions: Stand facing a wall or sturdy object, about an arm's length away.
Place your hands on the wall or object at shoulder height.
Step back with one foot, keeping your heel flat on the ground.
Bend your front knee slightly and lean forward, keeping your back leg straight.
You should feel a stretch in your calf muscle.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Repeat on the other leg.
description: The standing calves calf stretch is a bodyweight exercise designed to stretch the calf muscles. It is performed by standing facing a wall, placing your hands on the wall, stepping one foot back, and leaning forward to stretch the calf of the back leg.

name: Calf Push Stretch With Hands Against Wall
nameRu: Растяжка икр с упором руками в стену
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands against the wall at shoulder height.
Step back with one foot, keeping your heel on the ground and your leg straight.
Bend your front knee slightly and lean forward, feeling a stretch in your calf.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat the stretch.
description: The calf push stretch with hands against wall is a bodyweight exercise that targets the calves and also stretches the hamstrings. It is performed by standing facing a wall, placing your hands against it, stepping one foot back, and leaning forward to stretch the calf muscle.

name: Standing Calf Raise (On A Staircase)
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step or a sturdy platform with your heels hanging off and your toes on the step.
Hold onto a railing or wall for balance if needed.
Slowly raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The standing calf raise (on a staircase) is a bodyweight exercise that targets the calves by raising and lowering the heels while standing on the edge of a step. It also engages the ankles and feet for stabilization.

name: Assisted Lying Calves Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Bend one knee and place your foot flat on the ground.
Using your hands or a towel, gently pull your toes towards your body, feeling a stretch in your calf.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release the stretch and repeat on the other leg.
description: The assisted lying calves stretch is a flexibility exercise targeting the calves, performed lying on your back and using your hands or a towel to gently pull your toes toward your body.

name: Lever Calf Press
instructions: Adjust the seat of the leverage machine so that your shoulders are aligned with the lever pad.
Place your toes on the lever pad, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grasp the handles or side supports for stability.
Push the lever pad down by extending your ankles, contracting your calf muscles.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position by allowing your heels to rise back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever calf press is a machine-based exercise targeting the calf muscles. It involves pressing a lever pad with the toes while the heels hang off the edge, focusing on ankle extension to contract the calves. The movement is controlled and supported by the machine, making it accessible for most users.

name: Lever Rotary Calf
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are slightly bent and your feet are flat on the footplate.
Place your toes on the footplate, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the machine for stability.
Push through the balls of your feet, raising your heels as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever rotary calf exercise targets the calves using a leverage machine. It involves raising and lowering the heels while seated, focusing on the calf muscles and ankle stabilizers.

name: Sled Lying Calf Press
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the platform.
Place your toes and the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform, with your heels hanging off.
Push the platform away from you by extending your ankles, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Continue pushing until your calves are fully contracted.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower the platform back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled lying calf press is a machine-based exercise targeting the calves, performed by pressing a weighted sled away using the balls of the feet while lying on the machine.

name: Lever Seated Calf Press
nameRu: Жим икр сидя в рычажном тренажере
instructions: Adjust the seat of the machine so that your shoulders are aligned with the lever pad.
Place your toes on the lower portion of the platform and position your knees under the lever pad.
Grasp the handles on the sides of the seat for stability.
Press the lever pad down by extending your ankles, lifting your heels as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated calf press is a machine-based exercise targeting the calf muscles. It involves pressing a weighted lever with the balls of your feet while seated, focusing on ankle extension to work the calves.

name: Ankle Dorsal Flexion
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart; lightly hold a wall or chair for balance if needed.
Keep knees soft, torso upright, and weight centered over your heels.
Actively pull your toes up toward your shins (ankle dorsiflexion) without lifting the heels.
Pause briefly at end range while keeping ankles aligned and not turning the feet out/in.
Lower the forefeet slowly to the floor; avoid letting them drop or slapping the ground.
Repeat for controlled reps, staying within a pain-free range and even between sides.
description: Stand upright with feet hip-width, heels on the floor. Lift the forefeet by pulling the toes toward your shins, then lower under control.

name: Resistance Band Foot External Rotation
instructions: Sit tall on a bench or chair with knees bent ~90° and both feet flat, hip‑width apart.
Loop a small resistance band around the forefeet; keep the non‑working foot still to act as the anchor.
Brace your core, keep the working heel planted and shin vertical.
Rotate the working foot outward (eversion/external rotation), leading with the little toe; do not let the knee or hip twist.
Pause briefly at end range without pain, feeling the outer lower leg engage.
Return slowly to neutral under control; avoid the band snapping back.
Complete reps, then switch sides; keep movements small, smooth, and pain‑free.
description: Sit on a bench with a light loop band around both forefeet; one foot anchors the band while the other rotates outward against the resistance. Keep the heel down and move only at the ankle to train the lateral lower-leg muscles.

name: Resistance Band Foot Plantar Flexion
instructions: Sit tall on a bench or chair with knees at ~90° and the working heel lightly on the floor.
Loop the band around the ball of the working foot; anchor the other end under your opposite foot or hold it to create light tension.
Set the ankle in neutral (shin vertical, foot at 90°).
Press through the ball of the foot to plantarflex, pointing the toes away while keeping the knee still and heel gently grounded.
Pause briefly at end range without letting the ankle roll inward or outward.
Slowly return to the start over 2–3 seconds, controlling the resistance.
Repeat for reps, then switch sides; stop if you feel sharp pain in the Achilles or ankle joint.
description: Seated, loop a resistance band around the ball of the working foot and anchor the other end securely. Plantarflex the ankle by pointing the toes against the band, then return under control.

name: Resistance Band Foot Eversion
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with knees at 90 degrees and feet flat.
Loop the band around the ball of the working foot; anchor the other end under the opposite foot so it pulls the forefoot inward.
Keep the working heel lightly on the floor and the knee still; ankle starts neutral.
Evert the foot by sweeping the forefoot outward against the band without rotating the knee or hip.
Pause 1–2 seconds at end range, keeping toes relaxed and the arch lifted.
Return slowly to neutral under control, maintaining light tension in the band.
Complete 10–20 reps, then switch sides; adjust band length to achieve a pain‑free, controlled range.
description: Seated with a band looped around the ball of the working foot and anchored under the opposite foot, rotate the sole outward against the band. This isolates the ankle evertors to strengthen the lateral lower leg and support the ankle.

name: Resistance Band Foot Inversion
instructions: Sit tall with knees bent ~90°, heel of the working foot on the floor and toes slightly dorsiflexed.
Loop the band around the forefoot and anchor it to the outside (under the opposite foot or a sturdy object) so it pulls laterally.
Brace the lower leg; do not let the knee or hip move.
Pull the inside edge of the foot inward (invert) against the band in a slow, controlled motion.
Pause 1–2 seconds at end range without pain or cramping.
Return slowly to neutral under control; avoid letting the band snap you back or everting past neutral.
Keep heel down and avoid excessive plantarflexion; breathe steadily.
Complete desired reps, then switch sides.
description: Sit with a resistance band looped around the forefoot of the working leg and anchored laterally so it pulls the foot outward. Rotate the foot inward against the band to strengthen the medial ankle stabilizers, keeping the shin still.

name: Prancing
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, toes pointing forward, arms relaxed or in a gentle running swing for balance.
Shift weight to your right forefoot and press through the ball of the foot to lift the right heel high; keep the knee soft, not locked.
Keep the left heel lightly on the ground as you rise on the right, maintaining an upright torso and braced core.
Lower the right heel under control as you transfer weight to the left forefoot.
Lift the left heel high while the right foot returns to flat, continuing to alternate sides in a smooth rhythm.
Maintain even tempo, forefoot contact, and neutral ankles (don’t roll outward or inward).
Breathe steadily and stop before losing form or bouncing excessively.
description: Stand tall and alternately rise onto one forefoot while lowering the other heel, mimicking a light prancing motion. Keep the torso upright and move through a full ankle range with controlled rhythm.

name: Zigzag Hops
instructions: Stand athletic: feet hip-width, knees softly bent, chest up, eyes forward.
Load through the hips and ankles and hop diagonally over the line to the opposite side of the next cone, landing on the balls of your feet.
Absorb the landing softly by bending the ankles, knees, and hips while keeping knees tracking over toes.
Immediately rebound into the next diagonal hop, using arm swing for balance and rhythm.
Maintain a neutral torso and keep hops low-to-moderate and quick to emphasize control and reactivity.
Continue hopping past all cones, then walk back to recover and repeat for the desired reps or time.
If form degrades, slow the pace or reduce hop distance/height.
description: Set 4–6 cones in a straight line and stand to one side of the first cone. Hop diagonally from side to side over the line of cones, moving forward in a zigzag on the balls of your feet.

name: Exercise Ball On The Wall Calf Raise (Tennis Ball Between Knees)
nameRu: Подъем на носки с мячом у стены (теннисный мяч между коленями)
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and place an exercise ball between your lower back and the wall.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly in front of you.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Place a tennis ball between your knees.
Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: This exercise targets the calves by performing a calf raise while standing against a wall with an exercise ball supporting the lower back and a tennis ball held between the knees. Dumbbells are held for added resistance, and the movement requires balance and coordination.

name: Exercise Ball On The Wall Calf Raise (Tennis Ball Between Ankles)
nameRu: Подъем на носки с мячом у стены (теннисный мяч между лодыжками)
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place an exercise ball between the wall and your lower back.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Place a tennis ball between your ankles.
Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: This exercise targets the calves by performing a calf raise while holding a dumbbell in each hand, using an exercise ball for back support against the wall, and squeezing a tennis ball between the ankles to increase activation and control.

name: Front And Back Neck Stretch
instructions: Stand or sit upright with feet grounded, shoulders relaxed, and eyes forward.
For the back-of-neck stretch: place one or both hands on the crown and gently draw the chin toward the chest until you feel a mild stretch along the back of the neck.
Keep your torso tall without rounding the upper back; hold 15–30 seconds and breathe steadily.
Return the head to neutral slowly.
For the front-of-neck stretch: keep hands light for support and gently look upward, lengthening the front of the neck without collapsing or pinching the back of the neck.
Hold 10–20 seconds, breathing calmly, then return to neutral.
Repeat 1–3 times per direction; stop if you feel pain, tingling, or dizziness.
description: Stand or sit tall and use your hand(s) to gently guide the head into forward flexion to stretch the back of the neck, then into slight extension to stretch the front of the neck. Move slowly and only to a mild, comfortable stretch.

name: Neck Bridge Prone
nameRu: Мостик на шее лежа на животе
instructions: Place a thick pad on the floor; kneel with toes tucked, hands under shoulders, and forehead on the pad.
Gently tuck the chin to create a long neck and brace your abs.
Press into your forehead and toes to lift the knees slightly, raising the hips into a pike.
With hands lightly assisting, slowly shift your body forward to load the forehead without collapsing the neck.
Pause briefly, then shift back to reduce load while maintaining alignment and steady breathing.
Perform small, pain-free rocks for reps, keeping movements slow and controlled.
Lower the knees back to the floor to exit the position.
description: Kneel on a padded surface and place your forehead on the mat with hands for support, hips high. Shift your weight between forehead and toes in small, controlled rocks to strengthen the neck while keeping a tucked-chin position.

name: Side Neck Stretch
instructions: Stand or sit upright with feet hip-width apart, chest tall, and shoulders relaxed and down.
Keep your gaze forward and chin level (neutral neck).
Slowly tilt your head to the right, bringing your right ear toward your right shoulder without lifting or shrugging the shoulder.
Stop at a mild stretch on the left side of the neck and breathe steadily; hold 15–30 seconds.
Return to neutral slowly.
Repeat to the left side for 15–30 seconds; perform 2–3 rounds per side, moving gently and without pain.
description: Stand or sit tall and gently tilt your head to bring one ear toward the same-side shoulder to stretch the opposite side of the neck. Keep shoulders level and relaxed, hold the stretch, then switch sides.

name: Side Push Neck Stretch
nameRu: Растяжка шеи с надавливанием в сторону
instructions: Stand or sit up straight with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the right, bringing your right ear towards your right shoulder.
Place your right hand on the left side of your head and gently apply pressure to increase the stretch.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Repeat on the other side, tilting your head to the left and applying pressure with your left hand.
Repeat the stretch 2-3 times on each side.
description: The side push neck stretch is a gentle stretching exercise targeting the levator scapulae and other neck muscles. It helps improve flexibility and relieve tension in the neck and upper shoulders.

name: Weighted Lying Side Lifting Head (With Head Harness)
nameRu: Подъем головы лежа на боку с отягощением (с шлемом)
instructions: Attach a light plate to the head harness, secure it snugly, and lie on your side on a bench with shoulders and hips stacked.
Position your head just off the bench edge so the weight hangs toward the floor; lightly tuck your chin and keep the neck neutral.
Hold the bench for stability and keep shoulders relaxed; do not rotate your head.
Exhale and laterally flex your neck to lift your head toward your upper shoulder until your head is roughly in line with your torso.
Pause briefly at the top with control.
Inhale and slowly lower back to the start over 2–3 seconds, avoiding any bouncing or excessive range.
Complete the set, then carefully remove the weight and repeat on the opposite side.
description: Lie on your side on a bench wearing a head harness attached to a small plate, with your head hanging just off the edge. Side-bend your neck to lift the weight, then lower it under control without rotating.

name: Weighted Seated Neck Extension (With Head Harness)
nameRu: Разгибание шеи сидя с отягощением (с шлемом)
instructions: Sit near the edge of a bench with feet flat and torso slightly leaned forward; rest forearms on thighs to brace.
Secure the head harness so it sits snug and level; attach a small weight plate to the front ring.
Start with your chin gently tucked and neck flexed so the plate hangs vertically below your head.
Keeping your torso still, extend your neck by lifting your head until it aligns with your torso—avoid hyperextension.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower your head slowly to the starting position through a comfortable, pain‑free range.
Breathe out as you extend and in as you lower; move steadily without jerking and stop if you feel neck pain.
description: Sit on a bench wearing a head harness attached to a weight plate. With your torso braced and chin tucked, extend your neck to raise the weight, then lower back under control.

name: Neck Side Stretch
instructions: Stand or sit up straight with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to one side, bringing your ear towards your shoulder.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Repeat on the other side.
Perform 2-4 sets on each side.
description: A gentle stretch targeting the side of the neck, primarily the levator scapulae, performed by tilting the head to the side while standing or sitting.

name: Lever Neck Extension (Plate Loaded)
nameRu: Разгибание шеи в рычажном тренажере (с блинами)
instructions: Adjust seat so the head pad contacts the back of your skull (not the neck) and load light plates.
Sit upright with chest against the pad, feet flat, and spine neutral; grip the handles for stability.
Begin with a slight chin tuck and eyes forward; avoid slouching or arching the low back.
Exhale and extend the neck by pressing the head back into the pad until the head aligns with the torso—do not hyperextend.
Pause briefly while keeping shoulders relaxed and down.
Inhale and control the return by flexing the neck, bringing the chin slightly toward the chest within a comfortable range.
Move slowly and smoothly; stop if you feel neck pain, tingling, or dizziness.
description: Sit on a plate‑loaded neck extension machine with the head pad against the back of your skull and chest secured. Extend the neck to lift the lever, then slowly return to the start under control.

name: Lever Neck Left Side Flexion (Plate Loaded)
nameRu: Сгибание шеи влево в рычажном тренажере (с блинами)
instructions: Set the seat so the machine’s pivot is level with the base of your neck and load an appropriate plate.
Position the left head pad on the bony side of your skull above the ear (not on the jaw or ear).
Sit tall with your back against the pad, feet flat, and grip the handles to stabilize your torso.
Start with your head neutral, chin level, shoulders relaxed—do not shrug.
Exhale as you slowly flex your neck to the left, bringing your ear toward your shoulder without rotating the head.
Pause briefly at a comfortable end range without pinching or pain.
Inhale as you return to neutral under control, keeping the motion slow and the neck aligned.
description: Sit in a plate‑loaded neck flexion machine with the head pad positioned on the left side of your skull above the ear. Brace your torso and laterally flex the neck to bring your left ear toward your left shoulder, then return under control.

name: Lever Neck Right Side Flexion (Plate Loaded)
nameRu: Сгибание шеи вправо в рычажном тренажере (с блинами)
instructions: Adjust seat and pad so the head pad contacts the right side of your skull just above the ear with your neck in neutral.
Sit tall with feet flat; grip the machine handles to stabilize your torso and keep shoulders down.
Set chin level and eyes forward; avoid rotating the head.
Brace lightly and press the right side of your head into the pad, bringing your ear toward your shoulder.
Move through a comfortable, pain‑free range; do not shrug or twist.
Pause briefly at end range, then return slowly to neutral under control.
Maintain smooth breathing and consistent tension; complete all reps on the right, then train the left for balance.
description: Sit in a lever neck machine with the right side of your head against the pad and plates loaded to an appropriate weight. Keep your torso stable and laterally flex your neck to the right against the pad, then return under control.

name: Weighted Lying Neck Extension (With Head Harness)
nameRu: Разгибание шеи лежа с отягощением (с шлемом)
instructions: Set an incline bench and attach the head harness so the chain and plate hang directly below the back of your head.
Lie prone with chest on the bench, hips anchored, toes on the floor, and head past the edge.
Brace your core, depress and retract the shoulders; begin with the neck slightly flexed (chin gently tucked).
Extend the neck to lift your head until it aligns with your torso—avoid hyperextension or swinging.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping the torso still.
Lower your head slowly to the start position, maintaining control and a neutral upper back.
Use light to moderate load and stop if you feel sharp neck discomfort.
description: Lie face down on an incline bench with your chest supported and head hanging off the edge, wearing a head harness with a weight plate attached. Extend the neck to lift the head to neutral, then lower slowly under control.

name: Weighted Lying Neck Flexion (With Head Harness)
nameRu: Сгибание шеи лежа с отягощением (с шлемом)
instructions: Set a flat bench and lie on your back with shoulders near the edge so your head can move freely; plant your feet and brace your torso.
Fit the head harness snugly and attach a light plate so it provides resistance as you flex the neck.
Start with the neck slightly extended below neutral, eyes up, shoulders relaxed and down.
Initiate with a gentle nod, then curl your chin toward your chest by segmentally flexing the cervical spine.
Pause briefly in the top position without lifting the shoulders or hips.
Lower slowly for 2–3 seconds back to a slight, comfortable extension; keep the motion smooth and pain‑free.
Maintain steady breathing and keep reps strict; stop if form or control degrades.
description: Lie supine on a bench with your head off the edge, wearing a head harness attached to a light weight. Flex the neck to bring the chin toward the chest, then lower under control through a comfortable range.

name: Weighted Standing Neck Extension (With Head Harness)
nameRu: Разгибание шеи стоя с отягощением (с шлемом)
instructions: Fit the head harness snugly above the ears and across the forehead/occiput; clip the plate to the chain.
Stand feet hip‑width with soft knees, hinge slightly at the hips, and brace your core while keeping the back neutral.
Let the weight hang vertically; depress the shoulders and keep the torso still.
Begin with the neck slightly flexed (chin gently toward chest) without rounding your upper back.
Exhale and extend the neck by driving the back of your head upward until your face is level; avoid hyperextending past neutral.
Pause briefly, then inhale and lower the chin under control for 2–3 seconds; repeat for reps, stopping if you feel neck joint pain or dizziness.
description: With a head harness attached to a weight plate, stand and hinge slightly so the plate hangs freely. Extend the neck to bring the head to neutral, then lower back under control.

name: Cable Seated Neck Extension (With Head Harness)
nameRu: Разгибание шеи сидя на блоке (с шлемом)
instructions: Set a low pulley and clip the head harness ring to the carabiner.
Sit facing the stack with feet flat and torso upright; slide back until the cable is taut.
Put on the harness with the pad centered on your forehead and the strap snug.
Start with a slight chin tuck and mild neck flexion; keep shoulders down and core braced.
Exhale and extend your neck back until your head reaches neutral or a slight extension—do not arch the lower back.
Pause briefly, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position under control.
Maintain a smooth tempo, avoid jerking, and keep the range pain‑free; do not hyperextend.
Use small load increases and stop if you feel neck joint discomfort or tingling.
description: Sit facing a low cable stack wearing a snug head harness attached to the cable. From a slightly flexed neck position, extend the neck against the cable to neutral or slight extension, then return under control.

name: Cable Seated Neck Flexion (With Head Harness)
nameRu: Сгибание шеи сидя на блоке (с шлемом)
instructions: Set a cable pulley roughly at seated head height and select a very light weight.
Sit on a bench facing away from the machine; clip the head harness D‑ring behind your head to the cable.
Sit tall with feet flat, core braced, shoulders relaxed, and neck in neutral alignment.
Pre-tension the cable by scooting forward slightly without extending the neck.
Exhale and flex the neck, nodding the chin toward the chest through a comfortable range without rounding the torso.
Pause briefly, then slowly return to neutral while resisting the pull—do not hyperextend.
Keep the motion smooth and small; stop immediately if you feel pain or dizziness.
description: Sit facing away from a cable machine with a head harness attached to the cable at about head height. Keeping the torso still, flex the neck to bring the chin toward the chest against the cable’s pull, then return under control.

name: Chin Tuck
instructions: Sit or stand upright with shoulders relaxed and eyes looking straight ahead.
Brace lightly through your midsection and keep your jaw relaxed.
Without tilting your head up or down, draw your chin straight backward as if sliding your head along a track.
Feel the back of your neck lengthen and the front of your neck gently engage; keep eyes level.
Hold for 3–5 seconds while breathing normally.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for 8–12 controlled reps.
description: Sit or stand tall with neutral posture. Glide your head straight back to create a gentle double-chin, aligning the cervical spine; hold briefly, then return to neutral.

name: Assisted Chin Tuck
instructions: Stand with your upper back close to a wall, feet hip‑width, knees soft, chest tall.
Place one or two fingers on the tip of your chin to guide the motion; keep eyes level.
Without tilting the head, glide your chin straight back, making a small “double chin.”
Lightly touch the back of your head to the wall at the base of the skull while keeping the neck long.
Hold 3–5 seconds, breathe normally, and keep shoulders relaxed (no shrugging).
Slowly release to the start position and repeat for controlled reps.
Avoid jutting the chin forward, looking up/down, or opening the mouth during the movement.
description: Stand tall with your back near a wall and use your fingers to gently guide your chin straight backward to align the head over the spine. This assisted chin tuck reinforces cervical retraction without neck flexion or extension.

name: Barbell Front Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and lift the barbell forward and upward until it reaches shoulder level.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell front raise is a shoulder exercise that targets the deltoids by lifting a barbell from the thighs to shoulder height with straight arms.

name: Barbell One Arm Snatch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outwards.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your hips into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles, driving the barbell upwards.
As the barbell reaches chest level, pull it upwards with your arm, keeping it close to your body.
Rotate your elbow under the barbell and extend your arm fully overhead, locking out your elbow.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The barbell one arm snatch is an explosive, full-body movement that targets the shoulders (delts) and also engages the traps, forearms, and core. It requires coordination, balance, and strength to perform safely and effectively.

name: Barbell Rear Delt Raise
nameRu: Разведение рук со штангой на заднюю дельту
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Raise the barbell out to the sides, keeping your arms straight, until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell rear delt raise is an isolation exercise targeting the rear deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the traps and rhomboids. It is performed by hinging at the hips and raising a barbell out to the sides, focusing on shoulder movement.

name: Barbell Rear Delt Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Pull the barbell towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell rear delt row is a compound exercise targeting the rear deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the trapezius, rhomboids, and biceps. It involves pulling a barbell towards the chest while bent over, focusing on squeezing the shoulder blades together to engage the upper back and rear shoulders.

name: Barbell Seated Behind Head Military Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and bring it down to shoulder level, behind your head.
Press the barbell upward until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell seated behind head military press is a compound shoulder exercise that targets the deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and upper back. It requires good shoulder mobility and stability, as well as proper technique to avoid injury.

name: Barbell Seated Bradford Rocky Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell to shoulder height, keeping your elbows slightly bent and pointing forward.
Press the barbell overhead, fully extending your arms.
Lower the barbell back to shoulder height and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell seated Bradford Rocky press is a shoulder exercise performed while seated, focusing on pressing a barbell overhead to target the deltoids. It also engages the triceps and upper back as secondary muscles. The movement requires good shoulder mobility, core stability, and pressing strength.

name: Barbell Seated Overhead Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and bring it to shoulder level, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the barbell overhead by extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell seated overhead press is a compound strength exercise targeting the deltoid muscles of the shoulders. It also engages the triceps and upper back as secondary muscles. This movement is performed seated, which helps stabilize the lower body and focus the effort on the upper body. It requires proper technique and shoulder mobility to perform safely and effectively.

name: Barbell Skier
nameRu: Тяга штанги к поясу в наклоне (лыжник)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Simultaneously lift the barbell up towards your shoulders while jumping slightly off the ground.
As you reach the top of the movement, quickly reverse the motion and lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell skier is a dynamic shoulder exercise that involves lifting a barbell while performing a small jump, targeting the deltoids and engaging the triceps and core for stability.

name: Barbell Standing Bradford Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell in front of your shoulders with an overhand grip.
Press the barbell overhead, fully extending your arms.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell standing Bradford press is a shoulder exercise that targets the deltoids and also works the triceps and upper back. It involves pressing a barbell overhead from the front of the shoulders, requiring strength, coordination, and shoulder mobility.

name: Barbell Standing Front Raise Over Head
nameRu: Подъем штанги перед собой над головой стоя
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Slowly raise the barbell in front of you, keeping your arms straight and your palms facing down.
Continue lifting until the barbell is slightly above shoulder level.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell standing front raise over head is a shoulder exercise that targets the deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and upper back. It involves lifting a barbell from thigh level to overhead while standing, requiring control and shoulder strength.

name: Barbell Upright Row V. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Let the barbell hang in front of your thighs, arms fully extended.
Keeping your back straight, exhale and lift the barbell straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell upright row v. 2 is a compound exercise targeting the deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the traps and biceps. It involves lifting a barbell from the thighs to the upper chest by leading with the elbows, requiring good form to avoid shoulder impingement.

name: Barbell Upright Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Let the barbell hang in front of your thighs, arms fully extended.
Keeping your back straight and core engaged, exhale and lift the barbell straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell upright row is a compound exercise that targets the deltoids and also works the traps and biceps. It involves lifting a barbell from the thighs to the upper chest, leading with the elbows.

name: Barbell Upright Row V. 3
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Let the barbell hang in front of your thighs, arms fully extended.
Keeping your core engaged and back straight, exhale as you lift the barbell straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale as you slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell upright row v. 3 is a compound exercise targeting the deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the traps and biceps. It involves lifting a barbell from thigh level to chin height, leading with the elbows.

name: Barbell Wide-Grip Upright Row
nameRu: Тяга штанги к подбородку широким хватом
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands wider than shoulder-width apart.
Let the barbell hang in front of your thighs, arms fully extended.
Keeping your back straight, exhale and lift the barbell straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
