description: The dumbbell single leg deadlift is a unilateral lower body exercise that targets the glutes, hamstrings, and lower back. It challenges balance, coordination, and strength by requiring you to stabilize on one leg while hinging at the hips and lifting a dumbbell.

name: Single Leg Squat (Pistol) Male
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended in front of you.
Lift your right foot off the ground and extend it forward.
Slowly lower your body down by bending your left knee and pushing your hips back.
Keep your chest up and your back straight as you lower yourself down.
Lower until your left thigh is parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The single leg squat (pistol squat) is a challenging lower body exercise that targets the glutes, quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It requires significant strength, balance, and mobility to perform correctly, making it suitable for advanced practitioners.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, lower your body down into a squat position by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell goblet squat is a lower body exercise that targets the quadriceps while also engaging the glutes, hamstrings, and calves. It is performed by holding a dumbbell close to the chest and squatting down, making it a great movement for building strength and improving squat technique.

name: Side Bridge Hip Abduction
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Prop yourself up on your forearm, keeping your elbow directly below your shoulder.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
While keeping your core engaged, lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips.
Pause for a moment at the top, then lower your leg back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The side bridge hip abduction is a bodyweight exercise that targets the hip abductors, glutes, and obliques. It involves holding a side plank position while lifting the top leg, challenging both strength and stability.

name: Side Plank Hip Adduction
instructions: Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Prop yourself up on your forearm, keeping your elbow directly below your shoulder.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
While maintaining the side plank position, lift your top leg towards the ceiling, keeping it straight.
Slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The side plank hip adduction is a bodyweight exercise that targets the adductors while also engaging the obliques and glutes. It requires maintaining a side plank position while lifting the top leg, challenging both strength and balance.

name: Farmers Walk
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides.
Keep your back straight and your shoulders back.
Take small, controlled steps forward, maintaining an upright posture.
Continue walking for the desired distance or time.
To finish, stop walking and carefully lower the dumbbells to your sides.
description: The farmer's walk is a functional strength exercise where you walk while holding a dumbbell in each hand, engaging the quads, calves, forearms, and core. It improves grip strength, core stability, and overall conditioning.

name: Roller Hip Stretch
instructions: Start by sitting on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Place the roller under your glutes, just above your knees.
Lean back and place your hands on the ground behind you for support.
Engage your glutes and slowly roll the roller forward, bending your knees and bringing them towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, feeling a stretch in your glutes.
Slowly roll the roller back to the starting position, extending your legs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The roller hip stretch is a flexibility and mobility exercise that targets the glutes and also stretches the hamstrings and quadriceps. It uses a foam roller to help release tension and improve range of motion in the hip area.

name: Roller Hip Lat Stretch
nameRu: Растяжка широчайших мышц спины и бедра с роллом
instructions: Start by kneeling on the ground with the roller positioned under your hips.
Place your hands on the roller for support.
Slowly roll the roller forward, extending your hips and stretching your glutes.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then roll back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The roller hip lat stretch is a flexibility exercise that targets the glutes and also stretches the hamstrings and quadriceps. It uses a roller for support and to enhance the stretch, making it accessible for most people with basic mobility and balance.

name: Lever Hip Extension V. 2
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body and sit on it with your back against the backrest.
Place your feet on the footrests and grip the handles for stability.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, then push against the footrests to extend your hips and raise your legs backward.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever hip extension v. 2 is a machine-based exercise that targets the glutes and also works the hamstrings. It involves extending the hips against resistance provided by a leverage machine, making it a controlled and isolated movement for the posterior chain.

name: Lever Alternate Leg Press
instructions: Adjust the seat and foot platform of the leverage machine to your desired position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the foot platform.
Place your hands on the handles or sides of the machine for stability.
Push one foot against the foot platform, extending your leg until it is almost fully straight.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bend your leg and return to the starting position.
Repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever alternate leg press is a machine-based exercise targeting the quadriceps, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and glutes. It involves pressing one leg at a time against a foot platform, providing a controlled environment for building lower body strength.

name: Rear Leg Hook Kick
instructions: Adopt a fighting stance with the rear foot behind, knees soft, hands up, and core braced.
Pivot on the ball of the lead foot to open the hips while keeping the torso tall.
Chamber the rear leg by lifting the knee out to the side (hip abduction) with the knee bent and foot dorsiflexed.
Sweep the lower leg inward in a horizontal arc, adducting the hip to ‘hook’ the target and striking with the heel or back of the foot.
Re-chamber the leg immediately, then place it back to the starting stance under control.
Exhale on the strike, keep the supporting knee soft, and avoid locking the kicking knee or over-rotating the hips.
description: From a fighting stance, lift the rear leg to the side and sweep the heel inward across the target in a hooking motion. Pivot on the lead foot, keep the core braced, and maintain your guard throughout.

name: Front Leg Hook Kick
instructions: Stand in fighting stance with the lead foot forward, hands up, and most of your weight on the rear leg.
Pivot on the rear/support foot to open the hips and point the heel slightly outward.
Chamber the lead leg: lift the knee to hip height with the thigh slightly out to the side; dorsiflex the ankle so the toes pull back.
Extend the lower leg a bit past the target, then sweep the foot inward across the midline in a hooking arc, striking with the heel/edge of the sole.
Keep the core braced and the torso upright; do not hyperextend the knee at extension.
Retract the leg immediately along the same path and place the foot down to the starting stance.
Repeat for controlled reps, then switch sides.
description: From a fighting stance, lift the lead knee and perform a hook kick by extending slightly past the target, then sweeping inward to strike with the heel. Return the foot to the floor under control while keeping the torso tall and guard up.

name: Front Groin Kick
instructions: Stand in a staggered stance, feet hip-width apart, knees soft, hands guarding your chin.
Brace your core and center your weight over the support leg without leaning back.
Lift the lead knee toward your chest to chamber the kick, toes pointed slightly downward.
Snap the lower leg forward to groin height, striking with the instep/top of the foot.
Do not lock the knee at extension; stop the kick under control.
Immediately bend the knee to retract the leg along the same path.
Set the foot back under your hip to your original stance and reestablish balance.
Repeat for reps, then switch legs, maintaining posture throughout.
description: Stand in a fighting stance with hands up. Lift the knee and snap the foot forward to groin height striking with the instep, then quickly retract and return to stance.

name: Rear Axe Kick
instructions: Adopt a fighting stance with feet staggered, hands up, and core braced.
Shift weight to the lead leg and lift the rear knee, dorsiflexing the ankle (toes toward shin).
Extend the rear leg upward in front of you, keeping the leg mostly straight and torso tall.
At your top range, hinge from the hip and drive the heel straight down along the same line.
Land softly with the heel first, then the whole foot, near your centerline.
Retract the leg immediately and return to your fighting stance.
Keep the pelvis neutral, avoid hyperextending the low back, and do not lock the knee at the bottom.
description: From a fighting stance, lift the rear leg straight up in front of you and then drive the heel straight down like an axe before returning to stance. Keep the core braced and the foot dorsiflexed to strike with the heel.

name: Front Snap Kick
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with one foot forward, hands up, and core braced.
Shift weight to the support leg, keeping a slight bend in that knee and hips square.
Chamber the kick: lift the knee of the kicking leg to about hip height; plantarflex the ankle and pull the toes back to expose the ball of the foot.
Snap the kick forward by rapidly extending the knee, striking a low–to–mid target; exhale and keep the torso tall.
Re-chamber immediately by bending the knee and bringing the heel back under the hip (do not lock the kicking knee).
Set the foot down under control into your stance and repeat for reps, then switch sides.
description: From a fighting stance, lift (chamber) the knee and snap the lower leg forward to strike with the ball of the foot. Re-chamber immediately and return to your stance while maintaining balance and a braced core.

name: Spin Hook Kick
instructions: Start in a fighting stance with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft, and hands up.
Pivot on the lead foot and turn your head and shoulders first to spot the target, initiating the spin.
Rotate hips and torso, keeping the support heel turned outward to protect the knee.
Chamber the kicking leg by lifting the knee to the side (abduction) with the knee slightly bent.
Extend the leg and sweep the heel across in a hooking path, striking with the back of the heel at the target height.
Keep the core braced and torso upright; do not hyperextend the knee on contact.
Re-chamber the leg after the strike and place it down under control, returning to stance.
Reset balance, then repeat on the same or opposite side.
description: From a fighting stance, rotate and extend the leg in a sweeping arc to strike with the heel as you complete a spin. Maintain a tall posture and controlled re-chamber to return to stance.

name: Side Kick
instructions: Stand tall in a fighting stance, feet hip-width, hands up, core braced.
Shift weight to the supporting leg, bend it slightly, and pivot the supporting foot so toes turn away from the kicking side.
Lift the opposite knee toward the chest (chamber), heel tucked, toes pulled back, hips stacked.
Extend the leg out to the side, driving the heel toward the target at about hip height; keep the knee soft—do not lock out.
Keep torso upright and pelvis level; maintain a neutral spine throughout.
Briefly hold, then re-chamber the knee along the same path.
Lower the foot to the floor under control and repeat; switch sides evenly.
description: From an athletic stance, chamber the knee and drive a controlled side kick, leading with the heel. Pivot on the supporting foot, then re-chamber and lower under control.

name: Roundhouse Kick
instructions: Stand in fighting stance with feet shoulder-width, rear heel slightly raised and hands up to guard.
Shift weight to the support leg, pivot that foot so the heel turns outward and the hips open.
Chamber the kicking leg by lifting the knee across the body with the shin parallel to the floor.
Snap the kick by rapidly extending the knee, striking with the shin or instep; exhale on impact.
Keep the torso upright, core tight, and eyes on target throughout.
Re-chamber the leg immediately, then place it down under control and return to stance.
Repeat for reps, then switch sides.
description: From a fighting stance, pivot on the support foot, rotate the hips, and snap the lead leg across the target, then re-chamber and return to stance. Strike with the shin or instep while keeping the core braced and guard up.

name: Heel Push Kick
instructions: Stand in a staggered stance with hands up, feet hip‑width, core braced, and eyes forward.
Lift the lead knee toward the chest (hip flex), keeping the ankle dorsiflexed so toes point up.
Drive the hips forward and extend the knee to push straight out, striking with the center of the heel.
Keep the supporting foot rooted and pelvis level; avoid leaning back or rotating the hips.
Stop short of locking the knee, then immediately re‑chamber by bending the knee and pulling the leg back.
Return the foot to the floor under control and reset in your stance.
Repeat for reps, then switch sides to train both legs.
description: Stand in a fighting stance, raise the lead knee (chamber), then drive the heel straight forward to push the target before quickly re‑chambering and returning to stance. Keep the torso tall and strike with the heel by pulling the toes up.

name: Spin Back Kick
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with feet shoulder-width and hands up.
Shift weight to the lead leg and pivot on its ball, turning your hips and head to spot the target over your shoulder.
Chamber the rear leg by bringing the knee across and heel toward the glute, toes pointing down.
Extend the hip and knee to drive the heel straight back along a linear path, striking with the heel.
Keep the core braced and torso slightly inclined forward; maintain balance on the supporting foot.
Re-chamber the leg immediately after contact, then set it down and return to your stance.
description: From a fighting stance, rotate on the lead foot, look over your shoulder, then chamber the rear leg and drive the heel straight back. Re-chamber and return to your stance under control.

name: Split Squats
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with one foot and place it about two feet in front of the other foot.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight.
Continue lowering until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, and your back knee is hovering just above the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
description: Split squats are a lower body exercise that primarily targets the quadriceps, while also engaging the glutes, hamstrings, and calves. This bodyweight movement involves stepping forward into a split stance and lowering the body until the front thigh is parallel to the ground, then returning to the starting position.

name: Inverse Leg Curl (On Pull-Up Cable Machine)
nameRu: Обратное сгибание ног (на блочном тренажёре для подтягиваний)
instructions: Adjust the cable machine so that the ankle straps are at the lowest setting.
Lie face down on the bench with your legs extended and the ankle straps attached to your feet.
Hold onto the handles of the bench for stability.
Bend your knees and curl your legs towards your glutes, squeezing your hamstrings.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The inverse leg curl (on pull-up cable machine) is a bodyweight exercise targeting the hamstrings, with secondary emphasis on the glutes and calves. It involves lying face down, attaching ankle straps to a cable machine, and curling the legs towards the glutes.

name: Tire Flip
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the tire.
Bend your knees and hinge at the hips, lowering into a squat position.
Reach down and grab the bottom edge of the tire with both hands, fingers facing towards you.
Engage your glutes and leg muscles, and explosively drive through your legs to lift the tire off the ground.
As the tire flips over, use your upper body strength to guide it and maintain control.
Once the tire is fully flipped, quickly step back and reset your stance.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The tire flip is a full-body, explosive strength exercise that primarily targets the glutes, with significant involvement from the hamstrings, quadriceps, and core. It requires lifting and flipping a heavy tire, demanding power, coordination, and proper technique to perform safely.

name: Seated Piriformis Stretch
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your right knee and place your right foot on the outside of your left knee.
Place your left elbow on the outside of your right knee and gently twist your torso to the right.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides and repeat.
description: The seated piriformis stretch targets the glutes and helps improve flexibility and relieve tension in the piriformis muscle. It is performed seated on the ground, crossing one leg over the other and gently twisting the torso to stretch the gluteal region.

name: Rocking Frog Stretch
instructions: Start by kneeling on the ground with your knees hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the ground in front of you for support.
Slowly lean forward, shifting your weight onto your hands and extending your legs behind you.
Keep your back straight and engage your glutes as you push your hips back and up towards the ceiling.
Hold this position for a few seconds, feeling a stretch in your glutes.
Slowly return to the starting position by bending your knees and lowering your hips back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The rocking frog stretch is a bodyweight exercise that targets the glutes and also stretches the hamstrings and quadriceps. It involves kneeling, leaning forward, and rocking the hips back to stretch the lower body muscles.

name: Lever Horizontal One Leg Press
nameRu: Горизонтальный жим ногами одной ногой на рычажном тренажёре
instructions: Adjust the seat of the machine so that your knees are at a 90-degree angle when your feet are on the footplate.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
Place your hands on the handles or sides of the machine for stability.
Push the footplate away from your body by extending your leg, keeping your back against the backrest.
Pause for a moment at the fully extended position, then slowly bend your leg to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The lever horizontal one leg press is a lower body strength exercise performed on a leverage machine. It primarily targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. The exercise involves pressing a footplate away from the body using one leg at a time, which increases the demand for unilateral strength and stability.

name: Dumbbell Step Up Lunge
nameRu: Выпад с подъёмом на платформу с гантелями
instructions: Place two sturdy benches about a stride apart; hold dumbbells at your sides, chest up, core braced.
Put your front foot flat on the front bench and the top of your rear foot on the rear bench; hips square, eyes forward.
Inhale and descend straight down by bending both knees, keeping the front knee tracking over the middle toes and heel grounded.
Lower until the front foot lightly touches the floor (or front thigh is at least parallel), torso tall and neutral spine.
Exhale and drive through the front heel and mid‑foot to extend the knee and hip, returning to the start atop the benches.
Minimize push from the rear leg; keep dumbbells still and shoulders down.
Pause, re-balance, and complete all reps before switching legs.
description: Hold dumbbells at your sides and set up in a long split stance with the front foot on a bench and the rear foot elevated on a bench behind you. Lower straight down until the front foot lightly taps the floor, then drive through the front heel to step back up onto the front bench.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up Lunge
nameRu: Выпад с подъёмом на платформу с гантелями
instructions: Stand in front of a step or platform with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides.
Place your right foot on the step, ensuring your entire foot is on the surface.
Push through your right heel and lift your body up onto the step, bringing your left foot up as well.
Once both feet are on the step, lower your left foot back down to the starting position, keeping your right foot on the step.
Repeat the movement, alternating which foot you step up with each time.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell step-up lunge is a compound lower body exercise that targets the quadriceps while also engaging the glutes, hamstrings, and calves. It involves stepping onto a raised platform while holding dumbbells, requiring balance, coordination, and lower body strength.

name: Barbell Squat Jump Step Rear Lunge
nameRu: Приседание с прыжком и шагом назад в выпад со штангой
instructions: Rack the barbell across your upper traps with a shoulder-width grip; stand 15–30 cm in front of a sturdy step, feet hip-width and toes slightly out.
Brace your core, set a neutral spine, and sit into a quarter–half squat.
Drive through your feet and jump onto the step, landing softly on both feet with knees tracking over toes and heels down.
Stand tall on the step, then step one foot back to the floor and lower into a controlled rear lunge (front shin vertical, back knee under hip).
Push through the front heel to return to standing on the floor at the start position.
Repeat the jump and alternate the lunge leg each rep while keeping the torso upright and the bar stable.
Use a low step and light load; stop the set if landing control or balance is lost.
description: Set a barbell on your upper back and stand facing a low, stable step. Perform a squat jump to land on the step, then step back into a rear lunge before returning to the start.

name: Dumbbell Supported Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, slowly lower your body down by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell supported squat is a lower body exercise targeting the quadriceps, with additional activation of the glutes, hamstrings, and calves. It involves holding dumbbells at your sides while performing a squat, enhancing strength and stability.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Deadlift With Stepbox Support
nameRu: Румынская тяга на одной ноге с опорой на платформу и гантелью
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand.
Place your left foot on a stepbox or elevated surface behind you.
Keeping your back straight and core engaged, hinge forward at the hips, lowering the dumbbell towards the ground.
As you lower the dumbbell, simultaneously lift your left leg behind you, maintaining a straight line from head to heel.
Lower the dumbbell until you feel a stretch in your right hamstring, then return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The dumbbell single leg deadlift with stepbox support is a unilateral lower body exercise that targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and lower back. It challenges balance, stability, and strength, making it suitable for those with some experience in weight training.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Pull Through
instructions: Set feet wider than shoulder width with toes turned out 30–45°, grip one head of the dumbbell with both hands, arms straight and hanging between the legs.
Brace the core, keep a neutral spine, and push the hips back while bending the knees slightly; let the dumbbell travel between the thighs.
Keep shins near vertical, knees tracking over toes, shoulders packed, and weight through mid‑foot to heels.
At the end of the hinge, pause with the torso angled forward without rounding the back.
Drive the feet into the floor and snap the hips forward, squeezing the glutes to stand tall; let the arms stay straight as the dumbbell is pulled forward by hip extension.
Finish with hips and knees fully extended, ribs down, and no low‑back hyperextension.
Repeat by hinging again, guiding the dumbbell back between the legs under control; maintain a smooth tempo and neutral neck throughout.
description: Stand in a wide sumo stance holding a dumbbell with both hands between the legs. Hinge the hips to let the weight pass back between the thighs, then drive the hips forward to stand tall, pulling the dumbbell through without using the arms.

name: Barbell Split Squat (Version 2)
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell with an overhand grip just outside your thighs; feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot forward into a long split stance (front foot flat, back heel lifted, toes pointing forward).
Brace your abs, keep your chest up, hips square, and the bar close to your thighs.
Lower straight down by bending both knees; keep the torso tall and the front knee tracking over the middle toes.
Descend until the front thigh is near parallel and the back knee hovers just above the floor; keep weight through the front mid-foot/heel.
Press through the front foot and the ball of the back foot to return to standing without locking the knees.
Keep the bar level and close to the body; avoid letting the front knee cave inward or the heel lift.
Complete all reps on one side, then switch legs and repeat.
description: Hold a barbell with both hands at arm’s length in front of your hips and set up in a split stance. Lower straight down into a split squat and drive through the front foot to stand, keeping the bar close and level.

name: Barbell Split Squat V. 2
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
Take a large step forward with your right foot, keeping your torso upright.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg forward for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell split squat v. 2 is a lower body strength exercise that targets the quadriceps, while also engaging the glutes, hamstrings, and calves. It involves stepping forward into a split stance and lowering the body with a barbell across the upper back.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up Split Squat
nameRu: Сплит-приседания с подъёмом на платформу и гантелями
instructions: Stand in front of a bench or step with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Place your right foot on the bench or step, ensuring your entire foot is in contact with the surface.
Step up onto the bench or step with your right foot, pushing through your heel to lift your body up.
As you step up, simultaneously lift your left knee towards your chest.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your left foot back to the ground while keeping your right foot on the bench or step.
Repeat the movement with your left foot on the bench or step.
Continue alternating between your right and left foot for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell step-up split squat is a lower body exercise that targets the quadriceps, with additional emphasis on the glutes, hamstrings, and calves. It involves stepping up onto a bench or step while holding dumbbells, requiring balance, coordination, and strength.

name: Resistance Band Seated Hip Abduction
instructions: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Wrap the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Place your hands on the sides of the chair or bench for support.
Engage your abductors (outer thigh muscles) and slowly push your knees apart, against the resistance of the band.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bring your knees back together.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A seated exercise using a resistance band to target the hip abductors by pushing the knees apart against resistance. This movement also engages the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Resistance Band Leg Extension
instructions: Attach the resistance band to a sturdy anchor point and secure it around your ankle.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keeping your core engaged and your upper body stable, extend your leg straight out in front of you.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly return your leg to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The resistance band leg extension targets the quadriceps by extending the leg against the resistance of a band, helping to build strength and endurance in the upper legs.

name: Low Glute Bridge On Floor
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your arms by your sides, palms facing down.
Engage your glutes and core, then lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your glutes.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The low glute bridge on floor is a bodyweight exercise that targets the glutes while also engaging the hamstrings and core. It is performed by lying on your back, lifting your hips off the ground, and squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.

name: Potty Squat With Support
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold onto a stable support, such as a chair or wall, for balance.
Lower your body down into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Keep your chest up and your back straight throughout the movement.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The potty squat with support is a bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes, performed with the assistance of a stable support for balance. It is suitable for those developing lower body strength and proper squat mechanics.

name: Smith Sumo Squat
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at hip height.
Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing outwards.
Position yourself under the barbell, resting it on your upper back and shoulders.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your body down into a squat position, pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith sumo squat is a lower body exercise performed on a smith machine, targeting the glutes with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. The wide stance and guided bar path make it accessible for those developing squat technique and lower body strength.

name: Glute-Ham Raise
nameRu: Подъём корпуса на тренажёре для ягодиц и бицепса бедра
instructions: Adjust the glute-ham raise machine to fit your body.
Position yourself face down on the machine with your ankles secured.
Place your hands on your chest or cross them over your chest.
Engage your hamstrings and glutes to lift your upper body up towards the ceiling.
Continue lifting until your body is in a straight line from your head to your heels.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The glute-ham raise is a bodyweight exercise that primarily targets the hamstrings, with secondary emphasis on the glutes and lower back. It is performed on a glute-ham raise machine and requires significant strength and control to execute properly.

name: Frankenstein Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell in front of your body with straight arms.
Keeping your back straight, lower your body by bending at the knees and hips, as if sitting back into a chair.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The Frankenstein squat is a variation of the squat where the barbell is held in front of the body with straight arms, challenging the glutes, quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. This exercise emphasizes posture, core stability, and lower body strength.

name: Lever Lying Two-One Leg Curl
nameRu: Сгибание ног лёжа на рычажном тренажёре (двумя и одной ногой)
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body and sit on it with your back against the backrest.
Place your legs on the lever pad, just above your ankles.
Grasp the handles on the sides of the machine for support.
Keeping your upper body still, exhale and curl your legs up towards your glutes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever lying two-one leg curl is an isolation exercise targeting the hamstrings using a leverage machine. It involves curling the legs towards the glutes while lying on the machine, focusing on one leg at a time for increased intensity and muscle engagement.

name: Basic Toe Touch (Male)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down towards your toes with your hands, keeping your legs as straight as possible.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The basic toe touch is a bodyweight exercise that primarily targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and calves. It involves bending forward at the waist to reach towards the toes, providing a stretch to the posterior chain.

name: Arms Apart Circular Toe Touch (Male)
nameRu: Круговой наклон к носкам с разведёнными руками (мужской вариант)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended to the sides.
Keeping your legs straight, bend forward at the waist and reach down towards your toes with your right hand.
As you reach down, simultaneously lift your left leg straight up behind you, maintaining balance.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement with your left hand reaching towards your toes and your right leg lifting up behind you.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The arms apart circular toe touch is a bodyweight exercise that targets the glutes, hamstrings, quadriceps, and calves. It involves bending forward at the waist to touch your toes with one hand while lifting the opposite leg behind you, alternating sides to challenge balance and flexibility.

name: Hands Reversed Clasped Circular Toe Touch (Male)
nameRu: Круговой наклон к носкам с обратным замком рук (мужской вариант)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended to the sides.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down with your hands and clasp them together behind your legs.
Slowly raise your hands up and over your head in a circular motion, keeping your legs straight.
Continue the circular motion until your hands touch your toes.
Reverse the motion and bring your hands back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: This exercise involves standing with feet shoulder-width apart, bending forward at the waist, clasping hands behind the legs, and performing a circular motion with the arms to touch the toes, targeting the glutes and stretching the lower body.

name: Hands Clasped Circular Toe Touch (Male)
nameRu: Круговой наклон к носкам с замком рук (мужской вариант)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands clasped together in front of your chest.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Lower your hands towards your toes in a circular motion, reaching as far as you can without straining.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The hands clasped circular toe touch is a bodyweight exercise that targets the glutes and also engages the hamstrings, quadriceps, and calves. It involves hinging at the hips and making a circular motion with your hands towards your toes, promoting flexibility and mobility in the lower body.

name: Cable Assisted Inverse Leg Curl
nameRu: Обратное сгибание ног с помощью блока
instructions: Adjust the cable machine so that the ankle attachment is at the lowest setting.
Lie face down on the bench with your legs straight and the ankle attachment secured to your ankles.
Hold onto the handles of the bench for stability.
Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs up towards your glutes by flexing your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your hamstrings.
Inhale and slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable assisted inverse leg curl is an exercise targeting the hamstrings, performed using a cable machine to provide resistance as you curl your legs toward your glutes while lying face down.

name: Resistance Band Hip Thrusts On Knees (Female)
nameRu: Ягодичный мостик на коленях с эспандером (женский вариант)
instructions: Start by kneeling on the ground with your knees hip-width apart and your feet flexed.
Wrap the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Place your hands on your hips or extend them out in front of you for balance.
Engage your glutes and core muscles.
Push your hips forward and squeeze your glutes as you lift your knees off the ground, extending your hips until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Hold the position for a moment, then slowly lower your knees back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Resistance band hip thrusts on knees (female) target the glutes primarily, with secondary activation of the hamstrings and quadriceps. The exercise is performed by kneeling, using a resistance band for added tension, and thrusting the hips forward to engage the glutes.

name: Smith Full Squat
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at shoulder height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Step under the bar and position it across your upper back, resting on your traps.
Grip the bar with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and take a step back, maintaining a stable stance.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, initiate the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as your flexibility allows.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then drive through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith full squat is a compound lower body exercise performed using a smith machine. It primarily targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. The smith machine provides stability, making it accessible to those who may not be comfortable with free-weight squats, but still requires proper form and core engagement.

name: Strongman Fingal'S Fingers
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width at the free end of the hinged pole, shins close to the implement.
Grip the end securely with both hands underneath, chest up, shoulders packed, and spine neutral.
Brace your core, pull the pole tight to your body, and initiate the lift by driving through your heels, extending knees and hips together.
Keep the implement close as it rises past the knees; re-adjust your hand position if needed to transition from lifting to pushing.
Continue hip and knee extension while driving the pole upward; as it nears vertical, step forward under it and press through the arms to guide it over.
Finish by tipping the pole past its balance point under control, letting it fall safely to the opposite side.
Reset your stance on the new side, re-brace, and repeat. Avoid jerking, twisting, or rounding your back at any point.
description: Lift a hinged strongman pole (Fingal’s Finger) from the ground and drive it up using leg and hip extension, then press and walk it past vertical to tip it over. Reset on the opposite side and repeat for reps or distance.

name: Strongman Keg Toss
instructions: Clear a safe landing zone in front of you and stand shoulder‑width apart with the keg slightly in front, gripping the rims/sides securely.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back, soften the knees, and brace your abs as you pull the keg to swing slightly between your legs.
Drive through the floor and extend hips, knees, and ankles explosively, squeezing the glutes as the keg travels upward.
Keep the chest tall, shrug, and guide the keg overhead with straightening arms; release when the keg is on a rising arc slightly above eye level.
Finish tall with hips and knees locked out, keeping your body out of the keg’s path.
Let the keg land in the clear area, then walk to it and reset your stance and grip for the next repetition.
description: Explosive toss of a weighted keg using a powerful hip hinge and triple extension to project the load overhead. Set up in a shoulder‑width stance, hinge to load the hips, then drive upward to release the keg while keeping a neutral spine.

name: Barbell Weightlifting Complex
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, bar over midfoot, hands just outside legs; brace and set a neutral spine.
Initiate a power clean: push through the floor, extend hips and knees violently, shrug, then pull under and catch the bar on the shoulders with elbows high.
Set feet shoulder-width and perform one controlled front squat to comfortable depth, keeping torso upright and knees tracking over toes; stand tall.
Dip 2-3 inches by bending knees and hips together, then drive up and press the bar overhead to full lockout (push press) with ribs down.
Lower the bar back to the front rack, then to the hips, and guide it to the floor with control to reset.
Repeat the sequence for the prescribed reps, stopping if bar speed slows or form degrades.
description: Using a light-to-moderate Olympic barbell, perform a continuous sequence of a power clean to the front rack, one front squat, and a push press before returning the bar to the floor. Maintain a neutral spine and keep the bar close to the body throughout.

name: Strongman Car Flip
instructions: Stand facing the object with feet just outside shoulder width and toes slightly out; brace your core and set a neutral spine.
Hinge and squat to reach under the edge with a mixed or supinated grip, keeping the object close to your shins and chest up.
Pack the lats and take the slack out, then drive through your heels to extend knees and hips together to bring the object to mid‑thigh.
As it rises, step one foot forward and transition one or both hands to a pushing position on the edge.
Continue driving hips forward and use your legs and chest to tip the object past its balance point—do not curl with the arms.
Push it over and guide the descent, keeping fingers clear of the landing zone.
Reset your stance, re-brace, and repeat for the next rep, avoiding rounding or twisting under load.
description: Face the front edge of a heavy flip implement and squat to hook your hands under the lip. Drive through your legs and hips to lift, then step and push the object over under control.

name: Swimmer Kicks V. 2 (Male)
instructions: Lie face down on a mat with your arms extended overhead.
Engage your core and lift your chest and legs off the ground simultaneously.
Kick your legs up and down in a fluttering motion, as if you were swimming.
Continue kicking for the desired number of repetitions.
Lower your chest and legs back down to the starting position.
description: Swimmer kicks v. 2 (male) is a bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings, quadriceps, and calves. It involves lying face down and performing a flutter kick motion with the legs while keeping the chest and legs elevated off the ground.

name: Forward Lunge (Male)
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips.
Take a big step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Bend your right knee to about 90 degrees, keeping your knee aligned with your ankle.
Push off with your right foot and return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The forward lunge is a bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves stepping forward into a lunge position and returning to standing, alternating legs.

name: Glute Bridge Two Legs On Bench (Male)
nameRu: Ягодичный мостик с ногами на скамье (муж.)
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your back against it and your feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands on the bench beside your hips for support.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, then lift your hips off the bench until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The glute bridge with two legs on a bench is a bodyweight exercise that targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and core. It involves lifting the hips off the ground while the upper back rests on a bench, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders.

name: Quads (Bodyweight Squat)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body by bending your knees and pushing your hips back as if sitting on a chair.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A bodyweight squat exercise primarily targeting the quadriceps, with secondary activation of the hamstrings and glutes. This movement is fundamental for lower body strength and can be performed without equipment.

name: Bodyweight Drop Jump Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Jump up explosively, extending your hips, knees, and ankles.
While in mid-air, quickly bring your feet together.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately drop back into a squat position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The bodyweight drop jump squat is a plyometric exercise targeting the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves explosive jumping and rapid foot movement, challenging coordination, power, and lower body strength.

name: Quick Feet V. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Begin by rapidly moving your feet up and down, as if you were running in place.
Keep your movements quick and light, focusing on staying on the balls of your feet.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
description: Quick feet v. 2 is a bodyweight exercise that involves rapidly moving your feet up and down in place, focusing on speed and agility. It targets the quadriceps while also engaging the calves and hamstrings.

name: Glute Bridge March
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Engage your glutes and lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
While keeping your hips lifted, lift one foot off the ground and bring your knee towards your chest.
Lower your foot back to the ground and repeat the movement with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs in a marching motion while maintaining the bridge position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The glute bridge march is a bodyweight exercise that targets the glutes while also engaging the hamstrings and quadriceps. It involves holding a glute bridge position and alternately lifting each knee towards the chest in a marching motion, challenging hip stability and core strength.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge Two Legs On Bench (Male)
nameRu: Ягодичный мостик со штангой, ноги на скамье (муж.)
instructions: Start by sitting on the edge of a bench with your upper back resting against it and your feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart.
Place a barbell across your hips, holding it securely with both hands.
Engage your glutes and core muscles, then press through your heels to lift your hips off the bench, creating a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your glutes.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell glute bridge with two legs on a bench is a compound lower body exercise that primarily targets the glutes, while also engaging the hamstrings and core. It is performed by resting your upper back on a bench, placing a barbell across your hips, and driving your hips upward to create a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.

name: Lunge With Jump
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Push off with your right foot and jump into the air, switching the position of your feet mid-air.
Land softly with your left foot forward and immediately lower your body into a lunge position.
Continue alternating between lunges and jumps for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lunge with jump is a dynamic lower body exercise that combines a traditional lunge with a plyometric jump, targeting the glutes and also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It requires balance, coordination, and explosive strength.

name: Dumbbell Contralateral Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Take a step forward with your right foot, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Lower your body by bending both knees until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg.
Alternate legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell contralateral forward lunge is a lower body exercise that targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves stepping forward with one leg while holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand, challenging strength, balance, and coordination.

name: Bent Knee Lying Twist (Male)
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend your arms out to the sides, perpendicular to your body.
Keeping your knees together, slowly lower them to one side, aiming to touch the ground with your knees.
Pause for a moment, then engage your core and slowly lift your knees back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The bent knee lying twist (male) is a bodyweight exercise that targets the glutes and also engages the obliques and hip flexors. It involves lying on your back with bent knees and twisting them side to side, which helps improve flexibility and mobility in the lower back and hips.

name: Weighted Stretch Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with your right foot, keeping your back straight.
Lower your body by bending your knees until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The weighted stretch lunge is a lower body exercise that targets the glutes while also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves stepping forward into a lunge position while holding weights, then returning to the starting position and alternating legs.

name: Weighted Cossack Squats (Male)
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold a weight in front of your chest with both hands.
Shift your weight to one side and lower your body by bending the knee of the side you shifted towards, while keeping the other leg straight.
Go as low as you can while maintaining balance and keeping your chest up.
Push through the heel of the bent leg to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, alternating between legs.
description: Weighted cossack squats are a lower body exercise targeting the glutes, quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. This movement requires significant balance, mobility, and strength, as you shift your weight laterally and squat deeply on one leg while holding a weight.

name: Weighted Lunge With Swing
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight in each hand.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
As you lunge forward, swing the weights forward and upward, keeping your arms straight.
Push off with your right foot and return to the starting position, swinging the weights back down.
Repeat with your left foot and continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The weighted lunge with swing is a dynamic lower body exercise that combines a traditional lunge with an upper body swinging motion using weights. This movement targets the glutes primarily, while also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. The swinging motion adds a coordination and balance challenge.

name: Single Leg Bridge With Outstretched Leg
nameRu: Мостик на одной ноге с вытянутой ногой
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend one leg straight out in front of you.
Engage your glutes and lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The single leg bridge with outstretched leg is a bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and quadriceps. It challenges stability and unilateral strength by requiring you to lift your hips while keeping one leg extended.

name: Pike-To-Cobra Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Engage your core and lift your hips up towards the ceiling, forming an inverted V shape with your body.
Lower your upper body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
As you lower down, shift your weight forward and transition into a cobra pose by straightening your arms and lifting your chest up.
Reverse the movement by bending your elbows and lowering your chest back down towards the ground.
Push through your hands to return to the inverted V position.
Continue the movement by lowering your hips back down towards the ground, returning to the starting push-up position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The pike-to-cobra push-up is a dynamic bodyweight exercise that combines elements of a push-up, pike, and cobra pose. It targets the glutes primarily, while also engaging the core, shoulders, and triceps. The movement requires transitioning between an inverted V (pike) position and a cobra pose, demanding strength, flexibility, and coordination.

name: Side Lying Hip Adduction (Male)
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom arm under your head for support.
Engage your adductors and lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips or leaning backward.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The side lying hip adduction (male) is a bodyweight exercise targeting the adductors, performed while lying on your side and lifting the top leg upward.

name: Lever Seated Good Morning
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your hips are slightly higher than your knees.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the footrests.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the seat for stability.
Keeping your back straight, slowly lean forward from your hips until your upper body is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position by pushing through your glutes and hamstrings.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated good morning is a machine-based exercise targeting the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and lower back. It involves hinging at the hips while seated, using a leverage machine to provide resistance.

name: Curtsey Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step diagonally behind and across your body with your right foot, crossing it behind your left leg.
Bend both knees as if you were curtsying, lowering your body towards the ground.
Keep your torso upright and your weight on your front foot.
Push through your front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, stepping diagonally behind and across your body with your left foot.
description: The curtsey squat is a lower body exercise that targets the glutes and also works the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves stepping one leg diagonally behind and across the body, bending both knees to lower into a squat, and then returning to the starting position. This movement challenges balance and coordination in addition to strength.

name: Jump Box Over (Male)
instructions: Place a stable box in open space and stand beside it with feet hip‑width, knees soft, and chest up.
Brace your core, hinge slightly at the hips, and dip into a quarter‑squat while swinging the arms back.
Drive through the feet to jump up and laterally onto the box, landing softly with both feet flat, knees tracking over toes.
Immediately continue across the top and descend to the far side by a small hop or controlled step, landing softly on mid‑foot and absorbing with the hips and knees.
Reset posture on the floor, turn to face the box from the new side, and repeat back.
Keep a neutral spine throughout; avoid valgus knee collapse and do not catch the toes on the box.
If control or landing quality degrades, step down or lower the box height.
description: Stand to one side of a stable plyo box and jump laterally onto and over it, landing on the floor on the opposite side. Move explosively but land softly with control on each contact.

name: Dumbbell One Arm Snatch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Lower the dumbbell towards the ground, keeping it close to your body.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles, driving the dumbbell upwards in a straight line.
As the dumbbell reaches shoulder height, quickly rotate your hand and punch it overhead, fully extending your arm.
Catch the dumbbell overhead with a slight bend in your knees and hips.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: The dumbbell one arm snatch is a dynamic, full-body movement that targets the glutes, hamstrings, quadriceps, and core. It requires explosive power, coordination, and balance as you lift a dumbbell from the ground to overhead in one fluid motion.

name: Resistance Band Shuttle
instructions: Place a light-to-moderate loop band around your ankles and stand hip-width with toes forward.
Drop into a quarter-squat: hips back, chest up, core braced, knees tracking over toes.
Create slight outward tension on the band so the knees don’t collapse inward.
Step laterally with the lead foot 12–24 inches, then bring the trail foot in just enough to keep the band taut—no slack.
Keep hips level, feet parallel, and weight through midfoot/heels as you shuffle for the prescribed steps or distance.
Pause under control, then reverse direction leading with the opposite leg for equal distance.
Maintain a steady tempo and neutral spine; avoid torso rotation or letting knees cave inward.
Reset if posture or tension is lost before continuing.
description: Loop a resistance band around your ankles, assume an athletic quarter-squat, and shuffle laterally while keeping constant band tension. Move for the set distance, then reverse while maintaining knee alignment and a stable torso.

name: Broad Jump To Vertical
nameRu: Прыжок в длину с переходом в вертикальный прыжок
instructions: Stand with feet hip‑to‑shoulder width, toes slightly out, core braced, eyes forward.
Hinge and descend to a quarter–half squat with heels down and neutral spine, arms sweeping back.
Explosively swing the arms forward and triple‑extend hips, knees, and ankles to broad jump ahead.
Land softly on mid‑to‑forefoot then heels, feet under hips, knees tracking over toes, hips back.
Quickly absorb and rebound: swing the arms and drive straight up into a vertical jump.
Reach tall while keeping the torso upright and core tight.
Land softly again with knees and hips slightly bent; stabilize.
Reset spacing and repeat only while maintaining knee alignment and controlled landings.
description: From an athletic stance, jump forward in a powerful standing broad jump. Absorb the landing and immediately transition into a vertical jump, then land softly and reset.

name: Single Leg Board Jump
nameRu: Прыжок на одной ноге на платформу
instructions: Stand tall on one leg facing the board/target, core braced, hip–knee–toe aligned.
Hinge slightly and descend into a quarter squat, arms sweeping back, free leg behind for balance.
Drive through the standing foot, extending ankle, knee, and hip to jump forward.
Swing the arms forward to assist, keeping the torso controlled and knee tracking over toes.
Land softly on the same foot, ball-to-heel, with knee bent and hips back.
Hold and stabilize for 1–2 seconds without the knee collapsing inward.
Reset posture and repeat for reps, then switch legs.
description: Stand on one leg facing a low board or marked landing spot. Load into a quarter squat and explosively hop forward to land softly on the same leg, stabilizing before the next rep.

name: Single Leg Vertical Jump
instructions: Stand tall on one leg with the other knee slightly flexed and arms by your sides.
Engage your core, keep your chest up, and align the stance knee over the toes.
Hinge slightly at the hips and dip into a quarter squat to load the leg.
Swing the arms upward and drive through the whole foot, extending hip, knee, and ankle to jump vertically.
Lift the non-jumping knee up as you reach maximal height while keeping the torso neutral.
Land quietly on the same leg with a soft knee and hip, absorbing the impact through hip–knee–ankle.
Reset balance and repeat for reps, then switch legs. Keep the knee tracking over the toes and avoid valgus collapse.
description: Stand on one leg, dip into a quarter squat, then explode straight up using an arm swing. Land softly on the same leg, absorb the force, and reset before the next rep.

name: Straight Leg Hip Bridge
instructions: Lie supine with legs straight hip-width apart, heels on the floor and toes pointed up.
Brace the core and lightly posteriorly tilt the pelvis; keep knees extended without locking out.
Press the heels into the floor and squeeze the hamstrings and glutes to lift the hips.
Raise until your shoulders, hips, and ankles align; keep ribs down and neck neutral.
Pause 1–2 seconds while maintaining straight legs and level hips.
Lower the hips slowly to the floor without arching the lower back.
Exhale on the lift, inhale on the descent, and repeat for reps.
description: Lie on your back with legs straight and heels on the floor, arms across chest. Drive through the heels to lift the hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to ankles, then lower with control.

name: Stepdown Squat
instructions: Stand tall on a sturdy step 15–30 cm high; toes forward, hands on hips or out for balance.
Shift your weight fully over the working leg, keeping pelvis level and core braced.
Bend the stance knee and hip to descend, letting the free heel reach toward the floor in front.
Track the stance knee over the second–third toe; do not let it cave inward.
Lightly tap the floor with the free heel without transferring weight to it.
Press through the stance midfoot/heel to extend the knee and hip and return to the start.
Complete all reps under slow control, then switch legs.
description: Stand on a stable step with one leg as the support and the other foot hanging off the edge. Lower under control until the free heel lightly taps the floor, then drive back up to stand tall.

name: 3/4 Sit-Up
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The 3/4 sit-up is an abdominal exercise performed with body weight. It involves curling the torso up to a 45-degree angle, engaging the abs, hip flexors, and lower back. This movement is commonly used to build core strength and stability.

name: 45° Side Bend
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended straight down by your sides.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, slowly bend your torso to one side, lowering your hand towards your knee.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The 45° side bend is a bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles, particularly the obliques. It involves bending the torso to the side while standing, engaging the core for stability and control.

name: Air Bike
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your hands placed behind your head.
Lift your legs off the ground and bend your knees at a 90-degree angle.
Bring your right elbow towards your left knee while simultaneously straightening your right leg.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement on the opposite side, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee while straightening your left leg.
Continue alternating sides in a pedaling motion for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The air bike is a bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles and hip flexors. It involves a pedaling motion while lying on your back, alternating elbow-to-knee contact to engage the core.

name: Alternate Heel Touchers
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend your arms straight out to the sides, parallel to the ground.
Engaging your abs, lift your shoulders off the ground and reach your right hand towards your right heel.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the left side, reaching your left hand towards your left heel.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Alternate heel touchers is a bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles, particularly the obliques. It involves lying on your back, lifting your shoulders, and reaching side to side to touch your heels, engaging your core throughout.

name: Assisted Hanging Knee Raise With Throw Down
nameRu: Подъем коленей в висе с помощью и сбросом
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your knees towards your chest, keeping your legs together.
Once your knees are at chest level, explosively throw your legs down towards the ground, extending them fully.
Allow your legs to swing back up and repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The assisted hanging knee raise with throw down is an advanced core exercise that targets the abdominal muscles, with additional engagement of the hip flexors and lower back. The movement involves hanging from a pull-up bar, raising the knees to the chest, and then explosively throwing the legs downward, requiring significant core strength, coordination, and control.

name: Assisted Hanging Knee Raise
nameRu: Подъем коленей в висе с помощью
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core muscles and lift your knees towards your chest, bending at the hips and knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your abs.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The assisted hanging knee raise is an abdominal exercise performed while hanging from a pull-up bar, using assistance to help lift the knees toward the chest. It primarily targets the abs and also works the hip flexors.

name: Assisted Lying Leg Raise With Lateral Throw Down
nameRu: Подъем ног лежа с помощью и боковым сбросом
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Engage your abs and lift your legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
While keeping your legs together, lower them to one side until they are a few inches above the ground.
Pause for a moment, then lift your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The assisted lying leg raise with lateral throw down is an abdominal exercise that targets the abs while also engaging the hip flexors and obliques. The movement involves lifting the legs while lying on your back, then lowering them to each side in a controlled manner, which challenges core stability and strength.

name: Assisted Lying Leg Raise With Throw Down
nameRu: Подъем ног лежа с помощью и сбросом
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Engage your core and lift your legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
Raise your legs until they are perpendicular to the ground.
Lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Simultaneously, throw your legs down towards the ground, keeping them straight.
Raise your legs back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The assisted lying leg raise with throw down is an abdominal exercise that targets the abs while also engaging the hip flexors and quadriceps. The movement involves raising the legs while lying on your back, then forcefully lowering them (throwing them down) and raising them again, often with a partner providing resistance or assistance.

name: Assisted Motion Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the ground with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold the medicine ball with both hands in front of your chest.
Lean back slightly, engaging your abs and keeping your back straight.
Slowly twist your torso to the right, bringing the medicine ball towards the right side of your body.
Pause for a moment, then twist your torso to the left, bringing the medicine ball towards the left side of your body.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The assisted motion Russian twist is a core exercise performed with a medicine ball. It targets the abdominal muscles and also engages the obliques and lower back. The movement involves twisting the torso from side to side while holding a medicine ball, which adds resistance and helps build core strength and stability.

name: Barbell Press Sit-Up
instructions: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, resting it on your chest.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell press sit-up is an advanced abdominal exercise that combines a traditional sit-up with a barbell press, engaging the abs, shoulders, and chest. It requires significant core strength, coordination, and balance to safely press the barbell while performing the sit-up motion.

name: Barbell Rollerout From Bench
instructions: Start by kneeling on the floor with a barbell placed on a bench in front of you.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, slowly roll the barbell forward, extending your arms in front of you.
Continue rolling the barbell forward until your body is fully extended and your arms are overhead.
Pause for a moment at the fully extended position, then slowly roll the barbell back towards your body, returning to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell rollout from bench is an advanced core exercise that targets the abdominal muscles, with secondary emphasis on the shoulders and triceps. It requires significant core strength, stability, and control to perform safely and effectively.

name: Barbell Rollerout
instructions: Kneel on the floor and hold a barbell with both hands, shoulder-width apart.
Roll the barbell forward, extending your arms and keeping your core engaged.
Continue rolling forward until your body is fully extended and your arms are overhead.
Pause for a moment, then slowly roll the barbell back towards your knees, maintaining control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell rollout is an advanced core exercise that targets the abdominal muscles and also engages the lower back. It requires significant core strength, stability, and control to perform safely and effectively.

name: Barbell Seated Twist
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent.
Hold a barbell with both hands in front of your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Engage your core and slowly twist your torso to one side, keeping your back straight.
Pause for a moment at the end of the twist, then slowly rotate back to the starting position.
Repeat the twist to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell seated twist is an exercise that targets the abdominal muscles, particularly the obliques and lower back, by rotating the torso while seated and holding a barbell.

name: Barbell Side Bent V. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with both hands, palms facing down.
Keep your back straight and core engaged throughout the exercise.
Slowly bend your torso to the right side, lowering the barbell towards your right knee.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement on the left side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell side bent v. 2 is an exercise targeting the abdominal muscles, particularly the obliques, by bending the torso side to side while holding a barbell. It also engages the lower back for stability.

name: Barbell Standing Ab Rollerout
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Engage your core and slowly roll the barbell down towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your arms extended.
Continue rolling the barbell forward until your body is fully extended and your hands are directly above your head.
Pause for a moment, then slowly roll the barbell back towards your thighs, maintaining control and keeping your core engaged.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
